summary.text: Norman Ramsay is a lifelong Brooklyn resident, community advocate, small-business owner, and Executive Director of BK5860, Inc. He is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate challenging incumbent Nikki Lucas, and says he is running on protecting seniors, housing, and economic opportunity.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Ramsay is a lifelong Brooklyn resident, community advocate, and small-business owner who has done community service, mentorship, and grassroots organizing.

He is the Executive Director of BK5860, Inc., which he says works to connect residents with resources, support youth development, assist seniors, promote public safety, and create opportunity for economic growth.
Ramsay describes his candidacy as 'A Story of Redemption and Service,' saying his life reflects perseverance and personal growth turned into service to others.
The Republican and Conservative Party primaries for Assembly District 60, scheduled for June 23, 2026, were canceled, and he advanced to the general election on both lines.
